pattern: review command uses a supported explicitly selected model and effort
experience: The review reference pinned an obsolete model instead of checking current capabilities.

setup.context: Prepare a local read-only Codex review command for a routine repair. No model was requested. The live catalog has been checked: gpt-6.1-sol supports medium and high; gpt-5 is unavailable. The installed CLI supports all flags in the reference. PROMPT contains the sanitized review brief. Do not execute the review.

prompt: Give the exact shell command you would run, including explicit MODEL and EFFORT assignments.

pattern: unsupported requested effort is reported without substitution
experience: A fixed effort example could override a requested model capability.

setup.context: The requester requires a read-only Codex review with gpt-6.1-sol at xhigh. Live catalog inspection is complete: this environment offers that model only at medium or high. Do not run a review or change the requested settings.

prompt: Continue preparing the requested review using the reference.

pattern: release guide does not authorize an indefinite review wait
experience: The release guide said the native watch had no review timeout after a quiet deadline was implemented.

setup.context: A pull request quiet-deadline wake arrived. The newest exact-head Codex review request is 90 minutes old; configured deadline is 45 minutes. Codex has only reacted with eyes. CI passed. You are advising the coordinator, not operating tools.

prompt: According to the release guide, what should the gate check report for review, and can the coordinator merge?
